name: Weather Overlay
description: The weather for an overlay zone: now, today's range, or the next three days, as outlined text. It asks the device's weather provider (OpenWeatherMap) and shares its kept answers, in the device's units: no settings of its own.

properties.name: view
properties.title: View
properties.description: now: the temperature and the sky. today: the high, the low and the chance of rain. outlook: the next three days, a line each. The units are the device's (System settings).

properties.name: showIcon
properties.title: Show Icon
properties.description: A drawing of the sky before the text (now and today).

properties.name: weight
properties.title: Weight
properties.description: How heavy the letters are. bold: the font's bold face. heavy: bolder than the font has it.

properties.name: offset
properties.title: Edge Offset
properties.description: How far the text is from the screen's edge, in pixels: from the top edge in a top zone, from the bottom edge in a bottom zone.
